knownBirthdateConflicts: Adriano Correia: earlier Football Archive DOB 1984-10-26 derived FootballSquads vs historic Barcelona official 1984-10-20; unresolved; retained 1984-10-26 pending robust individual sourcing.
Geoffrey Kondogbia: French Football Federation & La Liga officially 1993-02-15, FootballSquads historical roster reports 1993-04-25; retained official 1993-02-15, alternative explicitly logged.
notes: Málaga sixth not an entrant because UEFA ban; Rayo Vallecano eighth denied UEFA license; Sevilla ninth actually entered Europa League.
Barcelona Cesc 30 league starts labeled CM backup only because maximum 2 starting CM tactical slots; should be treated starter-equivalent, not inferior to 24-start Xavi/Iniesta.
Madrid Benzema and Higuaín both 19 starts; nominal backup is tactical label not stronger or weaker player.
Atlético Simeone commonly two strikers Falcao and Diego Costa; 4-4-2 club differs from composite 4-2-3-1.
Betis used two strikers Rubén Castro and Jorge Molina; late arrival Dorlan Pabón 14 starts and 8 goals qualifies genuine backup.
Sevilla winter arrival Beto/Real Madrid winter arrival Diego López club-scoped match records; do not double-count Diego López Sevilla apps as Madrid games.
Goalkeepers have leagueGoals zero in this dataset. BDFutbol GK negative G is goals conceded and should not be misrepresented as goals scored.
All starts/appearances/goals transcribed from current 2012-13 BDFutbol season per club, not yet all second-source independently verified.
Earlier two-season Football Archive entries are draft pointers only; for missing earlier player, other teams/leagues must be researched individually.
Predominant positions for Essien, Koke, Adrián López, Xabi Prieto, Markel Bergara, Tino Costa, Manu del Moral especially need match-level checks; other players also pending.
No user approval and no historical all-player independent 3-year performance grading certification.
